result.title: Linear-Time Online Visual Geometry Transformer with Hybrid Architecture
result.summary: Transformer-based 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT and $π^3$ predict cameras, depth and point maps directly from many input views. Causal attention models such as StreamVGGT extend them to online video but cache all past tokens, so their total compute grows quadratically with the stream length. Recurrent models such as CUT3R and TTT3R keep a fixed-size state at constant cost, but they progressively forget early geometry. We present LinearVGGT, a hybrid model distilled from StreamVGGT, which uses Mamba2 layers for efficient sequence modeling in three of every four global layers. The remaining layers use register-guided sparse attention to retrieve a few relevant past frames, compensating for the limited exact long-range recall of Mamba2. Our distillation needs only 9\% of the GPU hours and 31\% of the training frames that StreamVGGT uses to learn from VGGT. LinearVGGT keeps an almost constant latency of 27 ms per frame over 1,024 frames and is on average $12 \times$ faster than StreamVGGT. It outperforms its teacher and is competitive with the state-of-the-art streaming model LingBot-Map, while running $2.5\times$ faster and using $2.7\times$ less memory.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LinearVGGT，一种蒸馏自 StreamVGGT 的混合架构在线三维重建模型：四分之三的全局层用 Mamba2 做序列建模，其余层用寄存器引导的稀疏注意力检索少量相关历史帧，在近常数每帧延迟下保持长程几何精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定大小循环状态与稀疏历史帧检索的组合，可为 LVR 中 latent 状态的容量—精确回忆权衡、视觉证据筛选与压缩记忆设计提供可供核查的结构线索；但论文面向几何重建，未涉及推理过程与答案生成，联系属方法层面。
